data.title: Your voice as an AI voice: the licence

items: **We make an AI voice from your recordings** to sing parts nobody has recorded yet.
**It's always marked as AI,** and credited by your name only if you choose.
**You can withdraw it here at any time:** it stops singing everywhere at once, and its files are deleted.

blocks.text: 1.1 This is a test fixture for the mock (web/tests/fixtures/ai-voice-licence.json). The real terms are server/resources/legal/en/ai-voice-licence.md.
